title: Real-world cooking robot system from recipes based on food state recognition using foundation models and PDDL

live_model.evidence: Fig. 7: "conversion results...in GPT-4o-2024-0513 and GPT-4o-mini-2024-0718...compared with those of GPT-4-0613" -- one illustrative broccoli-recipe example, not an aggregate score.

prompt.location: Sec (recipe-to-function-sequence conversion) describes the pipeline; only one worked example (Fig. 7) is shown

claim.metric: none aggregate (only one qualitative example transformation is shown for GPT-4o; the paper's quantitative "accuracy" statements refer to the separate visual food-state recognizer, not the LLM's recipe-to-function conversion)

data.source: custom recipes and a physical cooking-robot setup; not a released dataset

notes: This is primarily a robotics/PDDL-planning paper; GPT-4o's role (converting recipe text to a function sequence) is illustrated with one worked example, not scored across a test set.
